content.title: Timken 6305-2RS Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 25mm Bore x 62mm OD x 17mm Width, Rubber Sealed (2RS)
content.short_description: Timken 6305-2RS deep groove ball bearing with 2RS rubber seals on both sides. 25mm bore, 62mm OD, 17mm width; dynamic load rating 22.5 kN, static load rating 11.6 kN.
content.long_description:
The Timken 6305-2RS is a single-row deep groove ball bearing in the 6305 series, fitted with 2RS rubber seals on both faces to retain lubricant and restrict entry of dust, moisture, and debris. Bore diameter is 25 mm, outer diameter is 62 mm, and width is 17 mm, matching standard 6305-series envelope dimensions for direct replacement in existing housings and shaft fits.

Load ratings are 22.5 kN dynamic (C) and 11.6 kN static (C0), applicable to radial and combined radial/light axial loading typical of deep groove ball bearing designs. Maximum operating temperature is rated at 120°C, which should be checked against the seal material limits and lubricant type in the target application before installation.

This bearing is suited for general industrial rotating equipment applications specifying the 6305-2RS envelope and load class, including pumps, motors, gearboxes, and conveyor systems where a sealed bearing is required to reduce relubrication intervals.
